verdict.rationale: x402 documents agent-to-agent/API payment infrastructure (MCP-compatible tool-call discovery, AWS Bedrock AgentCore, Agentic Wallets) but there is no evidence of integration with named consumer chat/assistant surfaces like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or Copilot enabling buyers to complete purchases inside those chat UIs. The protocol targets machine-to-machine settlement, not consumer chat checkout flows in these specific products.
